dialogue.content: checked the balance and closed the app again.
moved a direct debit date by three days.
found a charge I didn't recognise. it was me.
had a low balance for a week between paydays. uneventful.
rounded up the change jar into the account.
had a large amount sitting there before a planned purchase.
read a thread about interest rates and learned nothing.
past about four hundred sitting in the current account the balance stops reading as a limit. below that I feel every purchase against it.
physical, almost. above it the number is just decoration.
compared two accounts for twenty minutes and switched neither.
cancelled a thing and immediately got an email offering a discount.
filed the receipts I'd been carrying around for a month.
updated the card details on one service and forgot the rest.
checked whether a refund had landed. it hadn't.
looked at last month's total and looked away again.
split a bill four ways and covered the rounding.
the months I stayed inside what I'd planned were the ones where the account looked nearly empty all the way through. the cushioned months I drifted past every single time.
every cushioned month I can find. it's very consistent.
set a reminder for a renewal I'd forgotten about.
bought the thing I'd had in a basket for three weeks.
worked out the annual cost of something and stopped there.
